products.name: Marty
products.title: Marty - Breathable short sleeve golf shirt
products.desc: Marty is back: a solid shirt with a contrasting colour on the collar and sleeve edges. This is a classic shirt with an edge — literally and figuratively. Made from stretch fabric, it offers excellent breathability and quick-drying performance, keeping you comfortable all day. With UV protection (20+) and ribbed collar and cuffs, Marty combines timeless style with modern functionality.

products.name: Muir
products.title: Muir - Breathable short sleeve golf shirt
products.desc: Muir features a dynamic all-over print with soft tonal layering, offering visual interest without overwhelming the silhouette. Crafted from VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric, it ensures excellent ventilation and rapid moisture transport. Stretch fibres encourage unrestricted motion, while the classic polo structure keeps the design grounded. Muir is an expressive yet refined option for players seeking standout style and advanced comfort.

products.name: Mulligan
products.title: Mulligan - Breathable short sleeve golf shirt
products.desc: Mulligan channels modern simplicity through strong colour blocking and a technical sleeve accent. The VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric enhances airflow and dries quickly, ensuring comfort during long, sunny rounds. Gentle mechanical stretch supports a natural swing path, while the ribbed collar adds a tailored finish. With its bold shoulder contrast and dependable performance, Mulligan is a confident warm-weather staple.

products.name: Medley
products.title: Medley - Breathable short sleeve golf shirt
products.desc: Medley showcases a refined print and streamlined silhouette tailored for warm-weather comfort. Engineered with VENTIL8™ PLUS fabric, it promotes airflow and quick evaporation, helping you stay focused as the heat builds. Its gentle stretch ensures fluid motion, while the tailored collar elevates the look. Soft, light, and expressive, Medley is designed for golfers who appreciate both visual character and reliable performance.

products.name: Luis
products.title: Luis - Windproof and water repellent golf jacket
products.desc: The Luis vest is an ultra-lightweight, quarter-zip windbreaker designed for maximum performance on warmer days. Weighing just 94g (3.34 ounces) in size medium, it offers the perfect balance of protection and breathability without the bulk. Made with INTERFACE-1™ technology fabric and Warming Effect #1, this short-sleeve vest is windproof and features a water-repellent finish to keep you dry in light rain.

products.name: Lawrence
products.title: Lawrence - Windproof and water repellent golf jacket
products.desc: With contrasting panels, the Lawrence two tone golf jacket has a streamlined silhouette. The bluesign® approved recycled polyester fabric is ideal for golf, it keeps out the wind and provides light protection from the rain. Features include a repositioned side seam for optimum comfort, elasticated cuffs, and an elasticated drawstring that the hem, all which contribute to the comfort and high performance of this jacket.

products.name: Larry
products.title: Larry - Windproof and water repellent golf jacket
products.desc: Weighing less than a sleeve of golf balls, Larry is one of our lightest jackets ever. This INTERFACE-1™ half zip windbreaker is made from a breathable, stretchy fabric with a water repellent finish. Galvin Green’s INTERFACE-1™ windproof collection includes jackets and pants tailored to provide varying levels of warmth, ensuring comfort on cool days.

products.name: Leo
products.title: Leo - Windproof and water repellent golf vest
products.desc: An ideal extra layer of warmth and wind protection, the Leo vest is an INTERFACE-1™ zip up vest designed for golfers seeking a layer of comfort in cool or cold conditions. Made from stretchy, breathable, windproof fabric that’s bluesign® approved, Leo offers lightweight protection without compromising freedom of movement.

products.name: Lane
products.title: Lane - Windproof and water repellent golf pants
products.desc: With built-in stretch, these Lane pants are comfortable and easy to play in, allowing you to move freely. The material is windproof and has a water repellent finish, without compromising on breathability. With front and back pockets, these pants are functional, and we love the streamlined cut. Rated with warming effect #2, these pants are ideal when it's too cold for regular golf pants and too dry for waterproof pants.

products.name: Lloyd
products.title: Lloyd - Windproof and water repellent golf jacket
products.desc: Wind, cold, and light rain are the most common conditions you’ll face on the golf course, which is why we designed the INTERFACE-1™ range. The Lloyd golf windbreaker features a sporty two tone design with contrasting panels, and a bold back stripe. Made from a windproof, water repellent fabric, Lloyd’s extreme breathability and stretch features allow the wearer full freedom of movement, making it an ideal jacket for the golf course

products.name: Dixon
products.title: Dixon - Insulating golf mid layer
products.desc: Made from a bluesign® approved fabric, the Dixon half zip golf mid layer feels comfortable and soft against the skin. This classic mid layer is great on the golf course and comes in handy when you need an extra layer out running, on the ski slopes, or during any other outdoor activities. Rated with warming effect #1, we recommend you size up for a looser fit.

products.name: Daxton
products.title: Daxton - Insulating golf mid layer
products.desc: With front piping and a printed chest graphic, Daxton is a stylish piece that can be worn on and off the golf course. Available in a wide range of colours and sizes, Daxton is designed to match bottoms, jackets, and shirts from the men’s collection. This half zip golf sweater belongs to a new eco-generation of INSULA™ bluesign® approved fabrics made 100% from recycled plastic bottles. We recommend you size up for a looser fit

products.name: Del
products.title: Del - Insulating golf vest
products.desc: Need an extra layer of warmth underneath your jacket or over your golf shirt? Del is a quarter-zip thermal golf vest is rated with warming effect #1, offering light thermal insulation. Made from an extremely breathable, quick dry fabric, Del is soft, stretchy, and feels great against the skin.

products.name: Dean
products.title: Dean - Insulating golf mid layer
products.desc: Dean brings old-school style and high-tech performance together in one standout midlayer, available in both vibrant colours and classic neutrals. Made from Galvin Green’s recycled polyester INSULA™ fabric, this half-zip sweater offers exceptional thermal insulation (Warming Effect #2) while remaining soft, stretchy, and easy-care. Thanks to its bluesign® approved, quick-dry, and extremely breathable construction, Dean keeps you warm and comfortable on the coolest days without weighing you down.

products.name: Adam
products.title: Adam - Waterproof Golf Jacket
products.desc: Described as “the new gold standard for golf waterproofs” — Galvin Green’s Pertex Shield collection showcases the next generation of golf rain gear. The Adam half zip waterproof jacket merges the performance features of a high-tech golf jacket with the ease of a pullover. Made from Pertex Shield 3-layer stretch fabric, this lightweight, breathable jacket keeps you dry and comfortable. Garment features include chest tabs that reduce the bulk at the front of the jacket during your swing, and repositioned side seams to reduce friction.

products.name: Aston
products.title: Aston - Waterproof Golf Jacket
products.desc: The Aston golf jacket is a versatile, high-tech outer layer for all-weather golf, part of Galvin Green’s award-winning DRYVR™ collection. Constructed from recycled polyester with next-generation GORE-TEX ePE fabric, it is waterproof, windproof, and highly breathable. The two-layer GORE-TEX design and lightweight mesh lining offer comfort and warmth without bulk, while the water repellent treatment repels rain and ensures protection in harsh conditions.

products.name: Air
products.title: Air - Waterproof short sleeve golf jacket
products.desc: Playing in the rain but can’t stand long sleeves? Galvin Green’s short-sleeve golf jackets have been a customer favourite since their debut, offering reliable protection from the elements without the bulk of sleeves or cuffs interfering with your swing. Air is a full zip golf rain jacket with contrasting panels on the sleeve. This lightweight, breathable jacket keeps you dry and comfortable. Garment features include chest tabs which allow you to reduce the bulk at the front of the jacket during your swing, and repositioned side seams to reduce friction.

products.name: Noah
products.title: Noah - Breathable golf pants
products.desc: These men’s golf pants incorporate a shirt gripper waistband and stretch function for a perfect fit. With front and back pockets, these pants are as functional as they are stylish. Plus, they have UV protection of 20+. Pair them with a cool golf shirt and enjoy a sunny day on the course.

products.name: Nixon
products.title: Nixon - Breathable golf pants
products.desc: With front pockets, back pockets, and a mechanical stretch, the Nixon golf pants for men are comfortable, practical, and easy to wear. Available in 16 sizes, these pants will fit a wide variety of golfers. Plus, this soft, lightweight fabric is bluesign® approved. Stay comfortable on hot days with golf clothing that’s been designed by golfers, for golfers

products.name: Paul
products.title: Paul - Breathable golf shorts
products.desc: Made from lightweight and quick dry fabric, you’ll stay cool and dry when the temperatures heat up. These breathable golf shorts for men include a shirt gripper waistband and a built-in stretch function for comfort and a perfect fit. They come with UV protection of 20+ for added cover on sunny days, and the shorts include front and back pockets. Light, soft, and comfortable - these shorts look great on the golf course and during lunch at the clubhouse.

products.name: Pedro
products.title: Pedro - Breathable golf shorts
products.desc: The Pedro golf shorts are designed for comfort and performance, made with VENTIL8™ PLUS technology for breathability and quick-dry properties. The mechanical stretch fabric ensures freedom of movement, while UV protection 20+ shields you from the sun. Front and back pockets offer practical storage, making these shorts perfect for long rounds on sunny days.

products.name: Donnie
products.title: Donnie - Insulating golf sweatshirt
products.desc: When you’re out on the golf course and it’s cold, you want warmth. But to play well, you don’t want cumbersome clothing. Meet Donnie, a lightweight, breathable, soft men’s golf hoodie with thermal insulation. Offering warmth without weight, Donnie is ideal underneath your jacket on cold days, or simply over a shirt when it’s cool.

products.name: Danby
products.title: Danby - Insulating golf mid layer
products.desc: Danby delivers streamlined warmth with a clean, athletic aesthetic. Featuring a fitted hood for added comfort and protection, this mid layer is crafted from 100% recycled INSULA™ fabric and provides Warming Effect #2 which is ideal for crisp morning rounds or layered play. The material stretches easily and breathes efficiently, helping regulate body temperature during long sessions on the course. Its quick-dry functionality and subtle detailing make Danby a practical go-to for golfers who value simplicity, comfort, and responsible design.

products.name: Carl
products.title: Carl - Merino golf sweater
products.desc: The Carl men’s merino v-neck sweater has a fully fashioned saddle shape at the shoulders and brand embroidery on the left sleeve. Merino wool is made from natural fibres, making it biodegradable and recyclable at the end of the product’s life cycle.
